author: gyalchester
body:
Age: 14
Timezone: AEST (UTC+10)
Do you have Teamspeak? Yes
Do you have Discord? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

- Yes ([These are previous, right now I am not in any staff position] eg. Platform Administrator on a SMP server, MOD+ on a faction server )

What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

- My biggest weakness has recently only overcome me which is community interaction, due to not being active for quite some time but this is definitely going to change as I am becoming more active throughout the week. I do feel like this might affect my moderating as community interaction and connecting with the Avicus community is very important to uphold and do on a regular basis but I should have no trouble in going on the forums every day and logging on. 

What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

- Leaders must definitely have leadership, confidence and passion to be a good leader. These traits are essential in having a leadership position in any category because it makes you stand out from the rest, distinguishes if you have a good relationship with your team or community, proves that you have a willingness to want to be there and that you love/understand what you are doing. I do believe that I have these qualities and that I can use them in certain positions to be a leader or to step forward and take control over a situation, this is because I have been chosen in positions like this before and I have performed generally well. In these circumstances, I do not take full control but allow others to also step in and help but make sure that it is completed to a high standard.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

- My ability to take responsibility of situations and to work in almost any teamwork activity or project. I think that what makes me stand out from others is that I am more willing to be open to ideas and my ability to listen to new contributions from the community and staff team. I work quite well in difficult situations especially with a team as we can work together to make the best decisions that will benefit us the most. Additionally, I believe that I do not like taking any shortcuts but prefer to make sure that everything is done to a good standard and nothing is left out or half finished. I am eager to tackle these types of situations and want to finish a job to the best of my ability.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

- When interacting with the community, you have to be absolutely certain of what you are doing, saying and portraying. This is essential so that you don't start something like a flame war or make everyone disagree with you. The skills you need for this are patience, being able to understand different situations from different points of view and being logical and clear. This is because you have to be able to wait for someone to help them, be able to make a logical understanding of a situation and have a clear understanding of what they are saying and where they are coming from. This is essential when communicating and interacting with the community because people are extremely different and you have to be sure of what you are doing so someone doesn't get angry or upset or have a negative point of view towards you or the community/server. I do believe that I have these skills and would be able to communicate with the community quite well.

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

- When moderating i believe the most important traits are being able to communicate with the community and other staff members, knowing the rules and the difference between someone who is hacking and not. These in my opinion are the most important because firstly, you have to know how to correctly interact with the community to make sure that the ‘space’ has a less toxic vibe, it is a better place to be in and it doesn’t encourage negativity, secondly it is very important to know the rules and punishments correctly, so that if someone asks you anything you will know the answer instantly and you would be able to help them easily. Lastly, you have to be able to determine who is hacking or not, this is essential if there are different opinions on different people and their ability, so you can judge if they are cheating or if they are legitimate.  

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

- Firstly i would report this to a higher staff member (Senior staff) and make sure that they have a general understanding of the situation and they can take it under control if anything bad happens, then i will approach the moderator in a calm, friendly way and ask them if they have evidence for some bans or if they really believe they are hacking or if it is the correct choice, if it then further goes of of hand then i know the higher ranked staff members can step in a take control easily.

You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

- I would ask the people inside of the channel to stop disrespecting the particular staff member and to also to stop being as racist as they. I would try and be as polite as possible but just because they are in the nightclub doesn’t mean that can offend a staff member in an extremely rude and racist way.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

- I would firstly take a screenshot of what he has posted, if i have permission to delete it i will and then if i don’t i will ask him to delete the screenshot of the thread. Then i will report this to a Senior or Admin so that they can take care of it. If any community members who are not staff saw this thread then i would ask them not to talk and spread this.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

- I would firstly start recording what is happening for evidence if this topic comes up, then i will ask them to calm down a bit and not do this to the certain users feeling angry or to stop this completely. If they continue then i will take the evidence to an admin and make sure that they know the story, what had happened and then also if they have it under control.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?

- I want to be a moderator because i want to be able to help the wider community, to create a better environment for pvp and a less toxic community. I want the community to have fun and not to have to put up to hackers. I would also like to get more experience with the avicus network and the community, also more experience with moderating as a whole would be very nice.

What does Avicus mean to you?

- Avicus is basically the only server i play on and which i have played the most on over my time playing on minecraft. I really enjoy interacting with the community and purely hanging out and making new friends on this network. 

Anything specific the staff team could do better?

- The quality of moderation, i think that not all of the moderators know the rules completely well of what i have seen. I think that if the moderators go over a rule ‘test’ sort of thing then you may be able to separate which moderators need to work more on their basic knowledge and understanding of the rules.

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

- I chose to apply because i want to help out on avicus. I would also like to get to know the community better and meet new people. Furthermore, i would like to be able to give a share back to the network and help out with anything i can.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Only thank you!
